Container.Name: lore-webgui
Container.Overview:
A web interface for Lore, the open source version control system from Epic Games. Browse repositories, read history, view files and diffs, and manage branches from a browser.
You need a running Lore Server. The Lore Server template in this repository sets one up.
Set Lore Server host to the IP or host name of your Lore Server. If it runs on this Unraid server, use your Unraid IP. Do not use localhost: inside the container, it points to the container itself. Clone commands in the web UI also show this address.
The web UI connects to the Lore Server on port 41337 for gRPC and port 41339 for file content. If you changed those host ports, add the variables LORE_GRPC_URL and LORE_HTTP_URL, such as http://[your Unraid IP]:41337.
There is no sign-in. Anyone who can open this page can read every repository, create repositories and branches, and delete branches. Keep it on your LAN. Do not forward its port. For access from outside, put it behind a reverse proxy that requires sign-in.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port the web UI listens on.

Config.Name: Lore Server host
Config.Description: IP or host name of your Lore Server, such as 192.168.1.10. If it runs on this Unraid server, use your Unraid IP. Not localhost.

Config.Name: Lore token
Config.Description: Optional. Leave empty unless your Lore Server requires sign-in. Every visitor uses this token, so give it the least access that works.

Config.Name: Max diff size
Config.Description: Files larger than this many bytes show no diff. 2097152 is 2 MiB.

Config.Name: History concurrency
Config.Description: Parallel revision lookups for each page of history.
